name: Skyline College Dual Enrollment (San Mateo County CCD)
org: Skyline College, San Mateo County Community College District
what_you_do: You can take tuition-free college classes through your high school and earn high school and college credit at the same time.
who_can_apply: Students at partner high schools: Jefferson Union HSD, San Mateo Union HSD, South San Francisco USD, Sequoia Union HSD and Gateway charter school. Need a C or better to get college credit.
deadline_text: No deadline on the page. Ask your counselor about each term.
how_to_apply: Sign up through your high school (talk to your counselor), submit the Skyline application on CCCApply, then attend an enrollment workshop to register and get parent approval.
notes: Grades become part of a permanent college record and can affect financial aid and college admission. Contacts on the page: hendrieg@smccd.edu or fuentesa@smccd.edu. Canada College and College of San Mateo run their own dual enrollment pages, not checked here.
